messages:
Alex C: Quick heads-up — after the GH Actions tweak to infra-ci (changed job ordering) I noticed ArgoCD started creating app resources before the k8s secrets were populated. Pods are crashlooping. Anyone else hit this?
Maria S: Yep saw that on a staging deploy earlier. Root cause was ArgoCD auto-sync picking up the commit right after Atlantis applied manifests. Secrets come from a separate apply that lags by a few seconds because of our secret bootstrap job.
Srini: Do we still have automatic ArgoCD sync enabled on those infra apps? If so it will happily sync once the commit is pushed even if secrets haven't reconciled yet.
Alex C: argo is auto-sync for all infra apps atm. We thought apply -> commit would be enough ordering-wise. Apparently the GH Action that triggers Atlantis apply finishes and pushes, and ArgoCD reacts before the secret provider job finishes.
Taylor: Quick ideas:
- add a pre-sync hook in ArgoCD that waits for the secret (e.g., a job that polls `kubectl get secret my-secret`)
- change GH Actions so the commit that ArgoCD watches only happens after secret apply completes (set a second commit or a status flag)
- use `argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave` annotations to force secret resources to be applied earlier than dependent resources
Srini: I prefer adding a short wait hook in ArgoCD for now (least change). Example pre-sync hook we used elsewhere:
```
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: wait-for-secret
  annotations:
    "argocd.argoproj.io/hook": PreSync
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: wait
        image: bitnami/kubectl:1.25
        command: ["/bin/sh","-c","until kubectl get secret my-secret -n infra; do echo waiting; sleep 2; done"]
      restartPolicy: Never
```
Maria S: That looks fine. Alternative: in GH Actions modify the apply workflow to set an output `apply_done=true` and make the job that pushes the commit depend on it. Example snippet:
```
jobs:
  atlantis_apply:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      applied: ${{ steps.set-out.outputs.applied }}
    steps:
      - id: run-apply
        run: ./scripts/atlantis-apply.sh
      - id: set-out
        run: echo "::set-output name=applied::true"
  push_commit:
    needs: [atlantis_apply]
    if: needs.atlantis_apply.outputs.applied == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: git commit -m "infra: post-apply"
      - run: git push
```
Alex C: Nice. Which is quicker to implement — pre-sync hook vs changing GH Actions? I'd rather not touch many pipelines right before Friday deploy.
Taylor: Pre-sync hook wins then. Low-risk and reversible. I'll open a tiny PR adding that job to the secret kustomize overlay. Will also add a short TTL to the job so it doesn't hang forever.
Srini: Also add a short annotation so the hook only runs for prod/staging apps where this matters. e.g., `argocd.argoproj.io/compare-options: IgnoreExtraneous` (or just label and target specific apps)
Alex C: Sounds good. Taylor — can you include a one-liner in the PR description explaining why (ArgoCD races with secret bootstrap) and link this thread? I'll review.
Taylor: On it, will target a patch today. Thanks :thumbsup:
atlantis-bot: Atlantis apply completed for plan: repo=infra, workspace=default, status=success
ci-bot: GH Actions: infra-ci workflow ran: atlantis_apply -> push_commit (skipped until PR merged)
